title: NYRR Rules of Competition (updated 12 August 2026)
claims: The rules page is dated Updated August 12, 2026.
The TCS New York City Marathon is organised under the rules and regulations of World Athletics, with World Para Athletics governing the Wheelchair Division.
NYRR courses are certified by USATF and/or World Athletics.
Participants may move to a slower wave and corral but may not move to a faster one, and starting in an earlier wave or corral may lead to disqualification.

Participants must follow the rules against receiving assistance; unofficial pacers and unregistered persons are not permitted on the course, and receiving assistance from anyone other than official personnel may lead to disqualification.

Participants may carry fluid containers of one litre or less in a hydration belt, in the front pockets of a hydration vest, or by hand, but not in backpacks or hydration bladders or containers on their backs.
Participants who do not complete the entire course will be disqualified, and anyone who leaves the course may only rejoin at the point where they exited.
Participants with missing or irregular split times at official timing checkpoints will be reviewed and may be disqualified.

Each race has a time limit set out in the NYRR Time Cutoff Policy; fluid stations and amenities may not be available after the course closes, and participants may be instructed to move to sidewalks or board the sweep bus.
Participants on the sweep bus may not cross the finish line, will not receive 9+1 credit and will not be included in the results.
